question: The retail price of a fan is Rs.2,530. If the manufacturer gains 10%, the wholesale dealer gains 15% and the retailer gains 25%, then the cost of the product is:
solution:
**Given:**

The retail price of a fan = Rs.2,530

The manufacturer gains 10%.

The wholesale dealer gains 15%.

The retailer gains 25%.

**Formula used:**

S.P = C.P × (100 + profit)/100

**Calculation:**

The S.P of wholesale dealer = The C.P of retailer

Let the cost price of a table be Rs. x

According to the question

x × 110/100 × 115/100 × 125/100 = 2530

⇒ x × 11/10 × 23/20 × 5/4 = 2530

⇒ x = 2530 × 10/11 × 20/23 × 4/5

⇒ x = Rs. 1600

**∴ The cost of production of the fan is Rs. 1600.**
